energy_semantics: Force-consistent electronic free energy in eV/cell; no vibrational free energy.
scope: Within-method numerical convergence of two frozen C4H8 structures. Do not rank different functionals by their absolute or relative energies. This does not establish relaxed-phase thermodynamic stability.
pairing_policy: Same method, all numerical inputs, native grids/effective density cutoffs, PAW multiplicities, runner, software and dispersion. Source SHA selects role. Latest successful retry selected; other attempts and duplicate aliases retained.
refinement_policy: Componentwise nondecreasing cutoff/kmesh/gpts/fine grid/effective density cutoffs, with at least one strict increase. Three compatible paired precisions, stable last two intervals and candidate agreement with the unique highest reference. Incomparable settings are never ordered by energy or by descriptive labels.
completion_policy: All included provenance families must pass and all planned points must have a compatible completed record; no incompatible or unfinished family is hidden by a passing family of the same method.
